title: Affine fibre-product consequence of a finite Galois tensor decomposition
statement: Let L be a field [def-pc-field-extension], E/L a finite Galois extension [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] with group Q = Aut_L(E), and let phi : E tensor_L E \to product_{q in Q} E be the L-algebra isomorphism sending a tensor a tensor b to (a q(b))_q. For pi : Spec E \to Spec L [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the fibre product W = Spec E x_{Spec L} Spec E [def-pc-fibre-product] is isomorphic over Spec E (via the first projection) to the finite coproduct of copies of Spec E indexed by Q; on the q-th component the first projection is the identity and the second projection is Spec q.
